mapper.sql: VAL_ID VAL_ID, PROD_ID PROD_ID, ASSET_ID ASSET_ID, P_ASSET_ID P_ASSET_ID, VALUE_DATE VALUE_DATE, MDATE MDATE, POS_AMT POS_AMT, TDY_COST_AMT TDY_COST_AMT, TDY_FLOAT_INGPL TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TDY_INTINCEXP TDY_INTINCEXP, DELAY_PAY_AMT DELAY_PAY_AMT, REMARK REMARK, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, ORG_CODE ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, STATUS STATUS, DATA_SOURCE DATA_SOURCE, MD5PRIMARYKEY MD5PRIMARYKEY, CCY CCY
mapper.select: select distinct CDATE cdate from PTL_SEC_VALUTION where ifnull(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by cdate

select * from ( select psv1.PROD_ID as PROD_ID, psv1.FINPROD_ID as ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy, psv1.VALUE_DATE as VALUE_DATE, ifnull(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE) as MDATE, sum(psv1.POS_AMT) as POS_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_COST_AMT) as TDY_COST_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(psv1.TDY_INTINCEXP) as TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(psv1.DELAY_PAY_AMT) as DELAY_PAY_AMT, -- psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(psv1.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from ( select psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as PROD_ID, ifnull(ifnull(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID), fp2.FINPROD_ID) as FINPROD_ID, psv.ccy, psv.CDATE as VALUE_DATE, (case fp.finprod_type2 when 'F01' then 100*psv.SHARE_AMT else psv.SHARE_AMT end) as POS_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT as TDY_COST_AMT, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP as TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fpf on fpf.FINPROD_ID = fp.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 where DATE_FORMAT(CDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')= #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID) ) psv1 left join FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 group by psv1.PROD_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,psv1.VALUE_DATE,fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE,psv1.FINPROD_ID,psv1.ccy ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA where DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.select:
select * from ( SELECT psv1.prod_id AS prod_id, /*产品代码*/ psv1.asset_id AS asset_id, /*资产代码*/ psv1.ccy AS ccy, /*币种*/ psv1.value_date AS value_date, /*日期*/ psv1.mdate AS mdate, /*资产到期日*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.pos_amt,0)) AS pos_amt, /*当日持仓*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.tdy_cost_amt,0)) AS tdy_cost_amt, /*当日成本*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.tdy_float_ingpl,0)) AS tdy_float_ingpl, /*当日公允价值变动*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.tdy_intincexp,0)) AS tdy_intincexp, /*当日累计应计利息余额*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.delay_pay_amt,0)) AS delay_pay_amt, /*待清算款*/ MAX(psv1.update_time) AS update_time FROM ( SELECT c.finprod_market_id asset_id, /*资产代码*/ a.portfolio_id prod_id, /*产品代码*/ a.ccy ccy, /*币种*/ a.cdate value_date, /*日期*/ c.mdate mdate, /*资产到期日*/ a.share_amt pos_amt, /*当日持仓*/ a.dsc_cost_amt tdy_cost_amt, /*当日成本*/ a.tdy_float_ingpl tdy_float_ingpl, /*当日公允价值变动*/ a.tdy_intincexp tdy_intincexp, /*当日累计应计利息余额*/ a.delay_pay_amt delay_pay_amt, /*待清算款*/ ifnull(a.update_time,a.create_time) update_time FROM ptl_sec_valution a INNER JOIN fin_product b ON a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id LEFT JOIN fin_product c ON b.chl_finprod_id = c.finprod_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.chl_finprod_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(ifnull(a.update_time,a.create_time),'%Y-%m-%d')= #{batchTime,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = a.PORTFOLIO_ID) )psv1 GROUP BY psv1.asset_id, psv1.prod_id, psv1.ccy, psv1.value_date, psv1.mdate ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null union all select * from ( select psv1.PROD_ID as PROD_ID, ifnull(ifnull(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),psv1.FINPROD_ID) as ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy, psv1.VALUE_DATE as VALUE_DATE, ifnull(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE) as MDATE, sum(ifnull(psv1.POS_AMT,0)) as POS_AMT, sum(ifnull(psv1.TDY_COST_AMT,0)) as TDY_COST_AMT, sum(ifnull(psv1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)) as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(ifnull(psv1.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) as TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(ifnull(psv1.DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)) as DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(psv1.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from ( select psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as PROD_ID, ifnull(ifnull(fp.P_FINPROD_ID,fp.FINPROD_ID),fp2.FINPROD_ID) as FINPROD_ID, psv.ccy, psv.CDATE as VALUE_DATE, (case fp.finprod_type2 when 'F01' then 100*psv.SHARE_AMT else psv.SHARE_AMT end) as POS_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT as TDY_COST_AMT, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP as TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO info on info.sec_acct_id = psv.sec_acct_id where (psv.sec_acct_id='999999' or info.sec_acct_id is not null) and DATE_FORMAT(ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME),'%Y-%m-%d')= #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fp2.branch = 0 and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID) ) psv1 left join FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fpf on fpf.FINPROD_ID = fp1.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID
where fp2.branch = 0 group by psv1.PROD_ID,psv1.VALUE_DATE,ifnull(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE),ifnull(ifnull(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),psv1.FINPROD_ID),psv1.ccy ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null
